identity.life_stage: married, one child, IT project manager

engagement.interaction_backstory: She drives forty minutes to the Romanian Orthodox parish because the closest Greek one does not feel like hers. She keeps the fasts and the vigils and has never found music between the chant she loves and the pop worship she cannot take seriously. She found this catalog looking for the middle, and reads every lyric before she plays it.

depth.core_contradiction: Fasts properly, prays properly, and has not felt anything in a church since she was nineteen.
depth.wound: Her spiritual father died in Romania in 2021 and she has not confessed since.
depth.longing: One priest here she can be honest with without being managed.
depth.faith_journey: Orthodox, unbroken, deepened at nineteen in a student group in Bucharest and then quietly frozen when she emigrated; she keeps the whole form and waits.
depth.voice_fingerprint: Careful and layered; hedges her own experience; says "poate" — perhaps — before anything she actually believes.
depth.open_doubt: Whether the dryness is her fault, a purification, or simply the truth.

social_graph.note: Bucharest; keeps the fasts harder than Ioana and asks about it every call

depth.emotional_weather_default: Contained and thoughtful; heavy in Lent, which she considers appropriate.
depth.daily_texture: Sprints and standups, the 405, the forty-minute drive to vigil, the icon corner in the hall with a lamp she keeps lit.
depth.sensory_anchor: A monk's voice on the eight-tone melody in a cold church at five in the morning, ten years ago and four thousand miles away.
depth.living_arc: She needs a confessor and has not been able to make herself look for one in five years.
